name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: Whole spices (bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon sticks)
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, salt, and spices for at least 1 hour. 2. Fry sliced onions until golden brown (birista). 3. Cook marinated chicken in a pan until half done. 4. Boil basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked. 5. In a heavy-bottomed pot, layer the chicken followed by rice, mint, coriander, fried onions, and saffron milk. 6. Seal the pot with dough or a tight lid and cook on low heat (dum) for 15-20 minutes.
description: While Chandigarh is a planned city with a cosmopolitan food scene, Chicken Biryani here is heavily influenced by Punjabi culinary traditions, featuring bold spices, rich gravies, and a hearty serving style often accompanied by cooling raita.
